items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned to stay alert to payment scams, with fraudsters continuing to target organisations through fake invoices and payment redirection tricks. Separately, property tech firm PEXA reports that confidence among homebuyers around scam risks is falling, suggesting more Australians are feeling uncertain about protecting themselves during property transactions — a high-value target for criminals.

If your role involves approving payments or handling financial transactions, always verify any change to bank account details by calling the supplier directly on a number you already have on file — never use contact details from the email or invoice itself.

featured.title: PEXA flags drop in scam confidence among homebuyers
featured.summary: Fewer Australians can spot property settlement scams, with confidence in identifying them falling to 41% as AI voice fraud worries grow.
